# A dormant bed is still occupied

The beds look empty from the gate. Under the leaves there are worms, bulbs and the labels I promised to replace. I keep writing winter as though the garden has stopped. [[Garden notebook]]: dormancy is a phase of work that is not visible at the surface. No purchase is needed to make the plot feel active again.
